name: Plate flags
summary: The poster's dish drawn on a plate from above (tostada, noodles, pizza or cake); friends stick a toothpick flag in it with 1 to 5 chillies of how badly they want it and a word or two.
useWhen: having fun in south america eating tostadas
made ramen from scratch, rate it
dontUseWhen: choosing where to eat as a group (use claw-pick)
planning a dinner (use congrats-dinner or potluck)
asking for food recs somewhere new (use try-this-here)

title.description: What it is in their words, shown in quotes as the title

dish.description: Which dish to draw; pick the closest

flags.description: Flags already in: how badly each friend wants it (1 to 5 chillies), their word or two, and optionally a socket 0 to 9
